column2: In Telegram, search for @BotFather, send /newbot, give it a name (for example Zond Robot) and a username ending in "bot". Save the token it gives you.

The brain code cuts your speech into sentences (16 kHz WAV, at most 6 seconds), sends each to the whisper-large-v3-turbo model with Indonesian as the language, and receives the text. The robot only responds to sentences that say its name.

Change NAMA_ROBOT (default Zond) and NAMA_PEMILIK as you like. Pick a short robot name that rarely comes up in everyday conversation, because the robot only responds to voice commands that say its name.
The screen shows a face with two blinking eyes, the status line at the top shows battery and distance from the body, the speaker says "Halo, aku Zond. Aku siap.", and the bot sends "Zond menyala".
Say "Zond, maju sedikit" (Zond, move forward a little)
the robot hears its name, answers, moves, and sends the conversation to Telegram
Say just "Zond", wait for the robot to say "Ya?", then speak
commands after "Ya?" do not need the name again (for about 8 seconds)
same, without needing to say the name

The robot does not respond when you say its name: check the Serial Monitor. Lines "[dengar] tanpa nama, diabaikan" (no name, ignored) show what it heard; if the name is written very differently, change NAMA_ROBOT to a name that is easier to pronounce clearly. The robot also does not listen while the speaker is making sound, including while music or radio is playing.

The camera and microphone can record other people at home. With DENGAR_NAMA on, every sentence it hears is sent to Groq to check whether it says the robot's name (at most 10 sentences per minute). Tell the people at home, switch the robot off when not in use, or set DENGAR_NAMA = false so the robot only listens after the TALK button.
Finally, chat: "Zond, maju sedikit lalu lihat ke kiri, ada apa di sana?" (Zond, move forward a little then look left, what is there?)
